cards.text: King David has been dividing the Levites into divisions (1 Chronicles 23:6). Now the list comes to the divisions of the gatekeepers, the men who guard the gates. First up, from the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore.
Meshelemiah has seven sons. Then comes a man named Obed-edom, and he has eight sons.

cards.question: Obed-edom has eight sons. Why, according to the passage?

answers.text: He had served the king well

cards.text: Obed-edom's son Shemaiah has sons of his own, and they rule over their families.

cards.question: Shemaiah's sons rule over their families because they are strong ___ men

cards.text: Name after name, all capable men, and Obed-edom's family comes to 62 in all, with 18 more from Meshelemiah. Friend, back in the Millers' kitchen, SIX little cookie cutters had me worn out!
Then comes Hosah the Merarite, whose sons and brothers come to 13 in all. His son Shimri is listed first, but he wasn't the firstborn.

cards.question: Hosah's son Shimri is listed first because his father appointed him as the first.

cards.text: All these gatekeeper divisions have duties ministering in the house of the LORD, just as their relatives did. Now they need to sort out who guards which gate.

cards.question: The gatekeepers need to decide who guards which gate. How do they decide?

answers.text: They cast lots for each gate

cards.question: When the gatekeepers cast lots for the gates, only the oldest men get a turn.

cards.text: The lots start falling. The East Gate goes to a man named Shelemiah, and the North Gate goes to his son Zechariah.

cards.question: Zechariah son of Shelemiah gets the North Gate. How does the passage describe him?

cards.text: The South Gate goes to Obed-edom. The West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the ascending highway go to Shuppim and Hosah.

cards.question: Obed-edom gets the South Gate. What do the lots give to his sons?
Every gate now has its gatekeepers. When are guards stationed at them?

cards.text: Each day, Levites stand guard all around, from six on the east to two pairs at the storehouse to four at the highway on the west. Every post, every day, which means NOBODY on this crew gets to hit snooze.

cards.question: All these gatekeeper divisions are descendants of Korah and Merari.
The gates are covered. What are the gatekeepers' fellow Levites put in charge of at the house of God?

cards.text: From Ladan's family, Jehieli and his sons look after the treasuries of the house of the LORD. And the officer over the treasuries is Shebuel, a descendant of Gershom.

cards.question: Shebuel, the officer over the treasuries, descends from Gershom. Whose son was Gershom?

cards.text: Shebuel's relative Shelomith and his brothers look after the things dedicated by King David, by commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and by the army commanders. Gifts from a KING, friend, and my mustache shakes just carrying one full cookie box across my own bakery.

cards.question: Shelomith and his brothers look after things dedicated by King David and by commanders. Where did some of those dedicated things come from?
Some of that battle plunder was dedicated to the repair of the house of the LORD.

cards.text: And this goes WAY back. Shelomith and his brothers also look after everything dedicated by Samuel the seer, by Saul son of Kish, Israel's first king, and by two army commanders: Abner son of Ner, who served Saul (1 Samuel 14:50), and Joab son of Zeruiah, who served David (2 Samuel 8:16).
Not every job here is at the gates or the treasuries. From the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons get the outside duties.

cards.question: Chenaniah and his sons have outside duties as officers and ___ over Israel

cards.text: From the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his relatives take charge of Israel west of the Jordan, for all the work of the LORD and the service of the king. That's 1,700 capable men. Seventeen. HUNDRED.
Jerijah is chief of the Hebronites. In the fortieth year of David's reign, strong, capable men turn up among the Hebronites at Jazer in Gilead, and friend, I want to know HOW.

cards.question: In the fortieth year of David's reign, how are those strong capable men at Jazer in Gilead found?

cards.text: Jerijah's relatives come to 2,700 capable men, all heads of families, and King David puts them over the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh. Two and a half tribes in their care, and I can't get ONE group chat to agree on a time!

cards.question: Jerijah's 2,700 men handle the affairs of the king, but none of the matters pertaining to God.
